text_blocks.snippet: Immunotherapy is a type of cancer treatment that uses the body's own immune system to fight cancer. It works by boosting the immune system's ability to recognize and destroy cancer cells, helping to overcome the mechanisms by which cancer cells can evade immune responses. Immunotherapy can be used alone or in combination with other cancer treatments like chemotherapy or radiation therapy.
